lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd4Ga2Sn4 (reduced formula Nd2GaSn2) is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis gives Ga centers eight Sn neighbors in a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement, while Nd and Sn each show 10 geometric neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ga and Nd polyhedra and between Nd polyhedra.
